<h2>Diagnose the sjSDM GPU Runtime</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Performs a non-aborting diagnostic of the Python, torch, and CUDA runtime
used by sjSDM. Strict GPU-only workflows should call
'validate_sjsdm_gpu_runtime()'.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>diagnose_sjsdm_gpu_runtime(verbose = TRUE)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. If 'TRUE' (default), progress and diagnostics are printed.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>This diagnostic always returns a result. Missing requirements are represented
by false or missing fields rather than an abort.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list with diagnostic fields, including success flags,
torch version, CUDA version, and GPU names.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[fit_jsdm_model()], [validate_sjsdm_gpu_runtime()],
[diagnose_sjsdm_setup()]
</p>

</main>
